sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module intends to introduce the dissertation process, including (1) identifying a dissertation topic related to empirical corporate finance, financial accounting, financial economics, or asset pricing; (2) how to conduct and write up a literature review and find an interesting research question; (3) how to conduct a research design, thereby forming a research proposal; and (4) understanding of different types of research methods and how to apply them appropriately.
sections.Learning outcomes: In completing the module, students should be able to demonstrate: A. A systematic understanding of knowledge and skills of how to do empirical research B. Originality in the application of knowledge, together with a practical understanding of established, applied techniques of research and analysis as used to interpret knowledge and practice in the area C. Conceptual understanding that enables the student to evaluate methodologies and develop critiques of them and, where appropriate, propose new practices
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The main delivery approach is a topic with different focuses in each lecture. Each lecture topic will guide students to start their dissertation preparation and implementation.
